notes.title: Skeletal Dance Party Winter update
notes.notes:
Hello,

Jesper from Catalope Games here. I hope that you are having a very comfy time indoor waiting for the snow to arrive. Here is a tiny update to Skeletal Dance Party adding some new Winter themed items. In additions to that the Skelepals have been busy decorating the entire dungeon. You can now find Christmas Trees with presents under them all over the place!

[h1]New features Skeletal Dance Party 1.7.3[/h1]
In addition to all other items from last Winter the following items can now be found in the dungeon.
[list]
[*] [b]Frost Wand[/b] - Magical wand usable by Reva that casts a bolt of ice dealing area of effect magical damage.
[*] [b]Frost Staff[/b] - Magical staff usable by minions that casts a bolt of ice dealing area of effect magical damage.
[*] [b]Hot Chocolate[/b] - Warm milk based drink that heals Reva and minions.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeletal Dance Party 1.5.11: Midsummer Hungover Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/e2120223c80565b58ddb83b97a344bfce15ebc68.gif[/img]

Hello,

Here is a tiny patch that reworks how the puzzles works. The new telekinesis mechanic introduced in the Midsummer Update made it really hard to solve the puzzles. I changed the looks of them, making it much more easy to select which part to rotate.

It also makes so you can see what statues that are rotated correctly or incorrectly by the light ray above them; red for incorrect and green for correct.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/c971994fd739837c5b6dca7de7baac53c0a74065.gif[/img]

[h1]Skeletal Dance Party 1.5.11: Midsummer Hungover update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Replaced puzzles with rotating gear towers with skeleton statues.
[*] Added rays above puzzle statues showcasing if statue is rotated correctly.
[/list]

Let me know if you have found any other bugs in the forums!

Kind regards,
[i]Jesper[/i]

notes.title: Skeletal Dance Party 1.5.10: Midsummer Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/6ff1ff204d5fce1fbe0bdebb52a4728d54dc4957.gif[/img]

Hello,

Jesper from Catalope Games here. I hope that you have wonderful summer and will soon have vacation. So far my summer is going quite good, but has been a bit to much rain and thunder. Here is an update focusing on making the physics more fun and adding some special things for Midsummer!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/82a428f39c9273fde004b2e84c9877560a8ccd2e.gif[/img]

[h1]Telekinesis[/h1]
Reva has studied really hard and mastered the art of telekinesis! She can now now pick up several items at once. The effect is also much more pretty and contains magical stars, this makes it much more powerful somehow.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/d282aa7ca30b6e0f0f7b20a2318db48bf27b4b36.gif[/img]

[h1]Midsummer[/h1]
It is midsummer and thus Maypole can be found all over the dungeon. Grab your skeletal friends, dance around them and pretend to be tiny frogs! You can also find Swedish Viking Helmets on top of the poles, so push all of them down!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/170345056a2f9d1e8b13d5a237954ca0d0262b35.gif[/img]

[h1]More fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] D-Pad rotates camera in correct horizontal direction.
[*] Books props have be picked up and deal damage when thrown.
[*] Spotlight can be picked up and deal damage when thrown.
[*] Eggs and baskets deal damage when thrown.
[*] Improved particle system performances.
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/KdJ6z7r][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/37a3aa6505dd8107831b70f84969b1bf772a95bc.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/CatalopeGames/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/dbf2a29f90d555296d06359b95216a05b0b163f7.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/CatalopeGames/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/34cee4e351371abc665d9bd6685535a84852767a.png[/img][/url]

If you find any more bugs let me know in the forums or any other social media, have a wonderful party!

notes.title: Skeletal Dance Party 1.3.0: Cute Dungeon Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/4ba836ecd3563f4d7de8299d03c3fb1da8aac37f.gif[/img]

Hello,
I hope that you are still having a wonderful and comfy winter. I found some spare time to continue to work on Skeletal Dance Party. Thus I present Skeletal Dance Party 1.3.0: Cute Dungeon Update! It comes with new environment, jump pads, destructible walls and one of the most requested features; a minimap.

[h1]Minimap[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/107a3022c6170d76e5aa5f15364a7fc4e0d835c7.jpg[/img]
Lost in the dungeon? You can now view the minimap using Tab, or select if playing with a gamepad.

[h1]Jump pad[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/24c52a98a9895cbaf033c217539e0a2eb9f2e66c.gif[/img]


Every good party needs bounce - and nothing gives more bounce than jumping pads. These nifty things can now be found in the dungeon and allows your skeletons to attack enemies from above! It also allows Reva to access some hard to reach places.

[h1]Destructible walls[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/e13804575a4240217c2e9dbe4f63f29b10f6736a.gif[/img]

Some of the walls in the dungeon are quite old and weak. Running into them will surely destroy them and reveal hidden areas!

[h1]More new things[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/a0de35afbb33410fc98ce0826c8c9fc9f312fcd3.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Added Spotlights, Large statues and small coffins props.
[*] Better item placement in dungeon.
[*] Better decorated dungeon.
[*] Added more props to hub world.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved Steam Gamepad support.
[*] Updated engine to Unity 2018.
[/list]

Please let me know what you think of the new features and if you find any bugs let me know in the forums.

notes.title: Skeletal Dance Party 1.2.0: Winter Patch
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/be492f3f372cd75730b89b0bfea4843bd8942eeb.gif[/img]

Winter is upon us and Reva's skeletal party has begun decorating the catacombs for Christmas. Take extra care to look underneath the Christmas trees while exploring, you might find something there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/fa0aa4791e73dbc9d24f6c8cb929d4b46031e454.gif[/img]

We are doing a holiday themes art contest with chances to win keys to Skeletal Dance Party. To participate draw a Skeletal Dance party character or characters in a holiday-themed scene or outfit and post to either our Amino, on Twitter, on Tumblr, Facebook or Instagram and use both #HauntedHolidays and #SkeletalDanceParty tags so we can find it. Reference art for all characters can be found [url=https://www.catalope.co/skeletal-dance-party/skeletal-dance-party-presskit/]here[/url], more fan art can be found in our [url=https://aminoapps.com/c/skeletaldanceparty/info/]Amino[/url].

[b]Terms:[/b]
[list]
[*] All entries must be original and drawn between now and the stroke of January 1st (GMT).
[*] Any entries in the SDP Amino must be tagged #HauntedHolidays.
[*] Any entries on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook or Tumblr must be tagged both #HauntedHolidays AND #SkeletalDanceParty.
[*] Keep it SFW.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/65b722045e11108d6e43e66c1cd7d36fc486801d.gif[/img]

[h1]Skeletal Dance Party 1.2.0 Changelog:[/h1]
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Christmas decorations. - Added Morgues to levels containing fresh bodies.
[*]Added more variation to level generator.
[*]Added Christmas items for minions; Snowball, Candy Cane and Santa Hat.
[*]Added more skeletal jokes.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug allowing secondary minions to drop items.
[*] Magic Shield no longer rotates with body.
[*] Fixed Floating Skull AI so it does not get stuck.
[*] Fixed some materials glowing with white color.
[*] Added text hint for how to drop items.
[*] Fixed Soul Torch attachment flame size.
[*] Fixed unassigned Voxels in Knight model.
[*] Reva walks up stairs better.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeletal Dance Party Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27766483/4d4ba883fa559789791d90ecf7522ec6d883a60a.gif[/img]

Here is a patch fixing issues we noticed people had in the released version. It is mostly things related to playing with gamepads. And changing texts around.

- Steam Trading cards now drops (it is not reflected in store page for some reason however).
- Improved description of many items.
- Fixed incorrectly placed block at Gucha's ending.
- Can reconfigure controls from in game menu.
- More clear on item popup is Reva can use item or if minions can use item.
- Right Trigger is default key for telekinesis on gamepad and right stick is default key for commanding minions.
- Puppet should not be able to equip items they can not equip.
- Items used for internal purpose should no longer show up in hub world.
- Correct font in options menu.
- Do not show cursor in menus when using gamepad.
